name: trail-running-training-decision-skill
title_zh: 越野跑训练决策：根据赛道数据定配速与补给
tagline_zh: 别再用路跑配速硬扛越野。输入爬升、距离、路面，它给出分段的配速区间、心率上限和补给点策略，让训练计划贴合真实山况。
tagline_en: Stop guessing pace on trails. Input elevation, distance, terrain—get segment paces, HR caps, and fueling plans.
why_zh: 不是简单套用路跑公式，而是内置了爬升折算、技术路面减速系数和补给热量缺口模型，按你的历史越野表现校准。
why_en: Not a road-pace formula. It uses climb conversion, technical-terrain slowdown factors, and caloric-deficit modeling, calibrated.
limit_zh: 只覆盖训练计划生成，不含比赛日实时导航或天气预警。需要你提供至少一次同类型赛道的完赛数据（距离、爬升、用时）。
limit_en: Generates training plans only—no live navigation or weather alerts. Needs one prior finish on similar terrain (distance, climb, time); otherwise.
